titulo: Middle East live: Yemen’s Houthi rebels report roughly 40 Saudi air strikes
cuerpo: Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthi rebels said Thursday that Saudi forces launched a barrage of roughly 40 air strikes on four provinces in the war-torn country. The militant group has recently launched repeated strikes on Saudi oil facilities as renewed fighting intensifies between the Houthis and Saudi-backed forces. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
